lotCoverageMax.quote: 35% floor area to total land area as a base
lotCoverageMax.note: Building area is the land area times a percentage. The base is 35%, plus 5% for garages, 5% for detached units and 8% if 70% or more of units front on landscaped courts, for a total of 53%.

notes: A lotting plan is part of the Detailed Development Plan; no lot dimensions or unit sizes are set.
Setbacks are guides: 20 ft from the curb to the face of a garage and 10 ft from the curb to the face of other buildings.
Minimum distance between adjacent buildings: 8 ft with no windows, 10 ft with windows on one wall, 20 ft with windows on both walls.
A cluster home development next to a single-family district needs a side yard of at least 10 ft.
Walls with less than 80% brick, stone or stucco need architectural drawings showing how maintenance will be kept to a minimum.
A wall between any two dwelling units must have at least a 2-hour fire rating.
Each unit needs a garage or carport, and at least 3 off-street spaces per unit; tandem parking may be acceptable.
